preamble.title: stellaris/tessera
preamble.description: Tessera (TSRA) reserve-backed stablecoin, sTessera yield vault and redemption queue for Cardano (Preprod)

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

reserve/ReserveRedeemer.title: ReserveRedeemer
reserve/ReserveRedeemer.description:
`holder` on Mint / Burn is the party whose eligibility is checked when the
 matching KYC switch is on; it is ignored while the switch is off.
 Mint, Burn, Attest, SetCap and VaultClaimBurn spend the Supply; SetPaused,
 SetKyc, Rotate, SetVault, OpenLoss and CancelLoss spend the Config; LossBurn
 spends both (and is the only one that may). A redeemer used on the wrong
 datum fails.

anyOf.title: SetVault
anyOf.description: Committee: repoint the vault whose Tickets may use `VaultClaimBurn`.

anyOf.title: OpenLoss
anyOf.description:
Committee: open a "loss pending" freeze of the vault's exits and stakes
 until `until` (at most 7 days from the transaction's lower bound).

anyOf.title: LossBurn
anyOf.description:
Committee: burn `qty` TSRA against a reported loss and close the freeze.
 `written_off` is the whole backing the loss destroyed (`qty` plus the
 open Tickets' share, burned later); `attested_reserve` falls by it.

anyOf.title: VaultClaimBurn
anyOf.description: Anyone: burn exactly the loss excess of one vault Ticket being claimed.

fields.title: balance
fields.description: TSRA the UTxO holds (besides ADA and the thread token), exactly.

fields.title: epoch
fields.description: Monotonic replay counter.

tessera/queue_state/FlowAction.title: FlowAction
tessera/queue_state/FlowAction.description:
Mint redeemer is unused.
 The redeemer of each withdraw-zero script: the queue policy it works on,
 and the action. Each script names its own action type below.

anyOf.title: FlowPayShort
anyOf.description:
Short mode (D-32): pay the head day's registered Requests. Lives here
 because it is `Settle` with the ShortState spent instead of referenced.

tessera/queue_state/QueueSpend.title: QueueSpend
tessera/queue_state/QueueSpend.description:
Spend redeemer of `redeem_queue`: the owner's plain cancel, or the gate to
 one of the three withdraw-zero scripts (which check everything else).

fields.title: kyc_mint
fields.description:
Per-action eligibility switches (Phase 2.3). When on, the action calls
 `tessera/eligibility.eligible`. All off on Preprod.

fields.title: kyc_stake
fields.description:
Read by the sTessera vault; stored here so one committee transaction
 controls every switch.

fields.title: eligibility_policy
fields.description:
Policy of the eligibility tokens (`validators/eligibility.ak` at launch).
 Set at genesis; `SetKyc` (committee) may repoint it, e.g. to a
 Midnight-issued credential policy, without a new reserve script.

fields.title: vault_policy
fields.description:
Script hash of the sTSRA vault whose Tickets may use `VaultClaimBurn`
 (Phase 2.5b). Empty until `SetVault` (committee) sets it; otherwise 28
 bytes. A reserve script parameter is impossible (the vault is
 parameterised by the reserve), so it lives here.

fields.title: loss_pending_until
fields.description:
POSIX ms until which a "loss pending" freeze is in force (Phase 2.5b);
 0 = none. Exits and stakes in the vault require `until <= lo`.

fields.title: epoch
fields.description: Monotonic replay counter for Config transitions.

tessera/reserve_state/ReserveDatum.title: ReserveDatum
tessera/reserve_state/ReserveDatum.description:
The Reserve State is two UTxOs at the reserve address (Phase 2.5a), told
 apart by their thread token (`reserve_threads.ak`) and by distinct datum
 constructors, so a Config can never be read as a Supply or the reverse.

 * Config: rarely changes (committee, switches). Exits, stakes and the
   eligibility registry read it by reference, so it is not spent by every
   TSRA mint or burn.
 * Supply: the hot books. Spent by every mint, burn, attestation and cap
   change.

 PROVISIONAL until counsel answers (SPEC.md §1): the committee model, the
 attestation format, any on-chain reserve asset and the KYC switches may
 still change.

fields.title: minted_supply
fields.description: TSRA currently in existence (1e-6 TSRA units).

fields.title: attested_reserve
fields.description: Reserve the committee last attested to, in the same units.

fields.title: mint_cap
fields.description: Committee-set ceiling on `minted_supply`, at most `rules.max_mint_cap`.

fields.title: attestation_epoch
fields.description: Number of attestations recorded so far (0 at genesis).

fields.title: attested_at
fields.description: POSIX ms of the last attestation (genesis: the bootstrap tx's lower bound).

fields.title: epoch
fields.description: Monotonic replay counter for Supply transitions.

tessera/vault_state/OpsAction.title: OpsAction
tessera/vault_state/OpsAction.description:
What `vault_ops` is asked to validate (Phase 2.5b, SPEC.md §3a.15). The
 State is spent under the matching `VaultRedeemer`, which only checks that
 the ops run exists and is bound to this vault.

anyOf.title: OpsClaim
anyOf.description: The State side of a Claim: the Ticket's own validator pays the owner.

tessera/vault_state/OpsRedeemer.title: OpsRedeemer
tessera/vault_state/OpsRedeemer.description:
The redeemer of the `vault_ops` withdrawal. `vault` names the vault policy
 whose State is being transitioned; the vault itself checks it equals its own
 policy, so an ops run cannot be borrowed for another vault.

tessera/vault_state/Position.title: Position
tessera/vault_state/Position.description: A long-tier lock: `shares` of class L, payable to `owner` from `unlock_at`.

fields.title: gen
fields.description:
The long class's generation when it was staked; an older generation was
 wiped out by a loss and unlocks for 0 TSRA.

tessera/vault_state/Ticket.title: Ticket
tessera/vault_state/Ticket.description:
A short-tier cooldown claim: `value` TSRA escrowed at request time,
 payable to `owner` from `claim_after`, scaled by the loss index.

tessera/vault_state/VaultDatum.title: VaultDatum
tessera/vault_state/VaultDatum.description:
Every UTxO at the vault address carries one of these (distinct
 constructors, so a Position can never be read as a State, etc.).

tessera/vault_state/VaultRedeemer.title: VaultRedeemer
tessera/vault_state/VaultRedeemer.description:
What the vault's spend validator is asked to do. Lives here (not in the
 validator) so the reserve can name `Claim` when it checks `VaultClaimBurn`.

anyOf.title: StakeShort
anyOf.description: Stake `amount` TSRA into the short tier for sTSRA.

anyOf.title: StakeLong
anyOf.description: Stake `amount` TSRA into a long-tier Position payable to `owner`.

anyOf.title: RequestUnstake
anyOf.description: Burn `shares` sTSRA into a cooldown Ticket payable to `owner`.

anyOf.title: Claim
anyOf.description: Claim a Ticket after its cooldown (spends the State and the Ticket).

anyOf.title: UnlockLong
anyOf.description: Pay out a long-tier Position after `unlock_at` (State + Position).

anyOf.title: ReportYield
anyOf.description:
Committee: credit delivered yield. Validated by `vault_ops` (the
 withdraw-zero script named in the vault's parameters): the vault only
 checks that the ops run is bound to it.

anyOf.title: SetBounds
anyOf.description: Committee: change the bounds within their hard limits (`vault_ops`).

anyOf.title: ReportLoss
anyOf.description:
Committee: a loss (SPEC.md §3a.2; `vault_ops`). Spends the State, the
 reserve Supply and Config (`LossBurn`) and, when needed, the first-loss
 State.

tessera/vault_state/VaultState.title: VaultState
tessera/vault_state/VaultState.description: The vault's single State: both share classes' books and the bounds.

fields.title: short_shares
fields.description: Total sTSRA in existence (class S shares).

fields.title: short_assets
fields.description: TSRA owned by class S.

fields.title: long_shares
fields.description: Sum of `shares` over live long-tier Positions (class L).

fields.title: long_assets
fields.description: TSRA owned by class L.

fields.title: loss_index
fields.description:
Cooldown loss index (`loss_index_start` at genesis); only `ReportLoss`
 lowers it, never below `rules.min_loss_index`.

fields.title: ticket_escrow
fields.description:
TSRA escrowed in open Tickets, at their CURRENT value (Phase 2.5b, D-11):
 the State does not hold it, but a loss is spread over
 `assets + ticket_escrow`. Raised by `RequestUnstake` (by the Ticket's
 value), lowered by `ReportLoss` (by the Tickets' share of the loss) and
 by `Claim` (by the payout); 0 at genesis.

fields.title: short_gen
fields.description: Class generations (D-18); bumped when a loss wipes the class out.

fields.title: vest_short
fields.description:
Reported yield not yet in the share prices (H2.1), per class. It is
 held in the State's TSRA and vests linearly from `vest_from` to
 `vest_until`; `fold` moves what has vested into `short_assets` /
 `long_assets`.

fields.title: protocol_bps
fields.description: Protocol share of gross yield, at most `exchange.max_yield_fee_bps`.

fields.title: first_loss
fields.description:
The first-loss reserve's script hash (Phase 2.5b, D-10): its State is
 found by the `state` thread token under this policy. Immutable.

fields.title: treasury_addr
fields.description: Receives the protocol cut the first-loss reserve does not take.
